messages:
jordan_billing: Anyone else seeing ledger post lag from webhook-processor? Backfill + retries are spiking the queue.

sam_eng: Yep, saw retries piling up on kafka-consumer. Processor is throttling NS calls after 429s. Backpressure = slow ledger writes.

maria_finance: Clients reporting invoices not showing in NetSuite for hours — cash application delayed :grimacing: 

jordan_billing: Log snippet: ``ERROR NS_POST 429 rate_limit exceeded for account acct_ABC on /ledger/post`` and processor shows `inflight = 300`

ashley_ops: I bumped the consumer max_inflight to 500 and paused the backfill job. We should avoid replaying older events until rate limit window resets.

sam_eng: We can't just increase inflight; NS will 429 harder. Plan: implement exponential backoff + per-account token-bucket. Also add idempotency key check before replay posts.

maria_finance: Short-term: can ops manually run a reconciliation to catch missed invoices? Need to report to sales.

ashley_ops: Started recon job run for last 6 hours, will DM results. Also created issue INFR-721 to add DLQ alerts.

jordan_billing: Found ~12 duplicate credit adjustments created by replayed webhook handlers — looks like no idemp key on adjustment endpoint.

sam_eng: Filed PR to add idempotency header + verification in handler. Will also emit metric `ns_post_duplicates`.

deploy-bot: deploy started: patch/webhook-idempotency to staging — 2m ETA

ashley_ops: :thumbsup: once staging verified we can promote and run small controlled backfill.

maria_finance: Thanks team. Can we also add an SLA note for sales ops? I'll draft a short update.
